Q

Where the Raya Trade mark goes

There is one place to upload a mark today, and it is per unit. The group has none, which is why Raya Trade has nowhere to go.

Setup › Business units › Unit marks

A row per unit, Upload / Replace / Remove. PNG only, transparent background. The mark shows large on that unit’s deck cover and small in the footer of every other slide. This is the SMO’s to set. Seven of the ten units already carry one — that is the RAYA DISTRIBUTION lockup in the footers below.

Setup › Branding — no mark, only colours

This page sets the accent and the navigation bar and nothing else. The knowledge base says it sets “the colours and the logo”, which has been wrong since the page was written.

A group mark — does not exist

Nowhere to put Raya Trade’s own lockup, so a unit with no mark shows its name and a supporting function shows nothing at all. You already asked for this once (“supporting function get the raya trade logo”) and it was recorded as decided and not built, because it needs a new control.

What I need from you

Recommended: add Group mark to Setup › Branding — one upload, used wherever a unit has none and on every supporting function’s deck. Then send me the Raya Trade PNG (transparent background) and I will put it in the demo tenant too.

It is a new control on a page you have never seen it on, so under rule 1c it gets its own mockup before it is built. Say the word and I will draw it in the next round.

What “the client brand colours” means here

No new colour is invented and no hex is written into the deck.

A divider takes --panel — the token Setup › Branding’s Navigation bar control sets. So the dividers wear whatever blue the tenant chose for their own navigation bar, and change the day they change it. The words on them take the three tokens that already exist for exactly this ground: white ink, the bar’s quiet ink for the sub-line, and the bar’s accent for the rule and the label.

WhatTokenValue todayOn the blue
The ground--panel#16325C—
The title--panel-ink#FFFFFF12.77:1
The sub-line and labels--panel-quiet#B7C4D87.24:1
The rule and SECTION--panel-accent#E6C65C7.66:1

The mark had to change on blue. The footer lockup is navy, and the plate that makes a mark readable on a dark slide is switched on by the page being in dark mode — which a blue divider on a light page is not. On these dividers the mark gets its white plate whatever the theme, or Raya Distribution would vanish into the ground.

SWOT

03

Strategic pillars

“then the strategic pillars”

There is already a slide here — the pillar roll-call you signed off last round. So the question is whether it becomes the divider or gets one in front of it.

Your choice

I recommend A. The roll-call already does a divider’s job — it names what is coming and carries no numbers — so B puts two dividers back to back and adds a slide to every unit’s deck. A also gives you the pillar names on the blue, which is closer to the Raya deck you sent.

In A the heading becomes Strategic pillars with the pillar names in the cards, so the word Pillars is not standing on its own.

04

Overall performance

“a final overall performance before the pillars where we stand”

New, and it opens the closing block: Pillars — where we stand, then Where the unit stands, then Notes and achievements.

Your choice

I recommend B. A prints 78% / 67% / 107% two slides before the slide whose whole job is those three numbers — and prints them without their colour bands or the change on last cycle, so the audience reads them once flat and once properly and cannot tell which reading is the real one.

If you want numbers on the divider anyway, tell me and A ships — but then the numbers should carry their bands, and I would say so on the slide.
